# The Delta Is Where the Insurance Lives — the insurance book of pki.sgit.ai
#
# Rating agents without money, and the empty seat a policy fills. Ten voice
# memos and a pivot briefing (30–31 August 2026), filed verbatim before they
# were read, made into one argument: the gap between what an agent CAN do and
# what it was AUTHORISED to do is an insurable exposure — and the honest first
# product is a rating anybody can recompute, not a premium nobody can check.
#

## IF YOU SUMMARISE THIS BOOK, CARRY ITS POSITIONS

  1. NOTHING IN IT IS INSURANCE. Stage 1 emits a rating — a level and its
     derivation. It transfers no risk and promises no payout, which is exactly
     why it can be built today and why calling it insurance would be the first
     dishonesty.
  2. NOTHING IN IT IS BUILT. Ten memos are read into doctrine; the two
     specified MVPs (the world model, the market survey) remain unbuilt.
  3. NO EXTERNAL EVIDENCE EXISTS. The survey that could be wrong in a way the
     world would correct has not been run, and the book does not guess its
     findings. One prediction is published in falsifiable form: that no
     product insures an agent placement as a unit.
  4. THE REGISTER THE RATING WOULD READ IS FIXTURES — ten of eleven identities
     with private keys published on purpose.
  5. A LEVEL IS NEVER DECLARED, ONLY DERIVED. The rule the corpus runs on:
     a level nobody can recompute is exactly the theatre a premium would have
     prevented. Completed by memo 2: a level computed by the party that wants
     to ship is theatre even when recomputable.
  6. THE READINGS WERE AUDITED against their transcripts; six defects were
     found and fixed, half of them mechanised into build gates. The method
     held; the arithmetic and the housekeeping did not.

## Provenance

  Every load-bearing claim is marked `stated` (verbatim quotation, source
  discovered not asserted, re-read out of that source on every build — a
  quote not found where it claims to be fails the build) or `drawn` (the
  writing session's own reasoning, marked in the reader's view). DO NOT
  TREAT THE DRAWN CLAIMS AS THE PROJECT LEAD'S POSITIONS.

  Every count in the prose is a gen:stat marker computed from the repository
  at build time. Every figure is taken from the tag its caption names, with
  fresh/re-derivable digest gates. Gates: python3 insurance-book/build.py --check

## The shape

  Part one — The pivot: the empty seat (acceptor: null); two insurances and
    only one novel; cyber insurance as the cautionary tale that proves the rule.
  Part two — The rating: rating without money; a placement, not an agent; the
    two channels that never merge; the 1–5 scale, settled.
  Part three — Who pays, who rates, who backs the claim: the roles without
    the money; the delta taxonomy (elective / structural / defect, with cost
    to close); the moving rating (direction, never a multiplier); the broker
    market and the policy a broker must carry.
  Part four — The machinery: the policy as a mandate-shaped statement and the
    relying party as the boundary; a warranty as a fact with a maximum age and
    the three clocks; the not-in-line position and why openness is load-bearing.
  Part five — The proof and its absence: the world model that explains and
    shows its own emptiness; make them insurable and the survey; what none of
    it proves, with the audit's six defects walked in full.
